subject: LEGAL NOTICE: Preserve Evidence Immediately (suspected data leak window)
body: This is a formal legal notice. We have reason to believe that a potential data exposure may have occurred between 2026-05-18 19:00-22:30 UTC involving employee account access logs and potential download events. You must preserve relevant evidence immediately, including: (1) web/app access logs, (2) proxy/DLP detections, (3) mailbox delivery metadata for outbound messages, and (4) any incident tickets created during that window. Do not alter, delete, or anonymize records. A written confirmation is required by end of day today.

subject: [Alert] Possible compromise indicators - suspicious sign-in patterns detected
body: We observed anomalous sign-in patterns from two geo regions within 20 minutes. Indicators show increased authentication failures, then a single successful session using a new device fingerprint. No confirmed exfiltration markers are present yet, but this may precede further activity. Please validate: (a) whether any records downloads occurred, (b) whether OAuth token grants spiked, and (c) if any mailbox access from service accounts occurred after 08:35 UTC.

subject: [SECURITY MONITOR] Scan activity increase (no data transfer confirmed)
